description: A temporary increase in body temperature, often due to an infection like flu or viral illnesses. Normal body temperature is around 37°C (98.6°F).
prevention: Stay well hydrated with clean water and ORS. Rest in a well-ventilated room. Practice regular handwashing to avoid infectious agents.
when_to_seek_help: Seek immediate medical care if temperature exceeds 39.4°C (103°F), persists beyond 3 days, or is accompanied by stiff neck, confusion, or breathing trouble.

description: Viral upper respiratory tract infection causing sneezing, sore throat, runny nose, congestion, and mild body aches.
prevention: Wash hands frequently with soap. Avoid touching your eyes, nose, and mouth. Get annual influenza vaccination. Maintain safe distance from infected individuals.
when_to_seek_help: See a doctor if fever lasts more than 3 days, symptoms worsen after improving, or you experience severe earache or chest tightness.

description: A natural reflex that clears irritants from airways. Can be dry or productive (producing phlegm), caused by viral infections, allergies, or pollution.
prevention: Avoid smoking and secondhand smoke. Stay hydrated, use steam inhalation, drink warm fluids with honey and ginger. Avoid known air allergens.
when_to_seek_help: Consult a doctor if coughing lasts more than 3 weeks, produces blood or rust-colored sputum, or is accompanied by shortness of breath.

description: A chronic metabolic disease characterized by elevated levels of blood glucose (blood sugar) due to insulin resistance or deficiency.
prevention: Maintain a balanced low-glycemic diet, engage in 150 minutes of moderate weekly exercise, maintain optimal weight, and avoid smoking.
when_to_seek_help: Consult an endocrinologist if you experience extreme unquenchable thirst, frequent night urination, blurry vision, unexplained weight loss, or slow-healing sores.

description: A long-term medical condition in which blood pressure in the arteries is persistently elevated (above 130/80 mmHg).
prevention: Limit sodium intake to under 2,000 mg/day. Eat potassium-rich vegetables, reduce saturated fats, exercise regularly, manage stress, and limit alcohol.
when_to_seek_help: Seek emergency care if systolic pressure exceeds 180 mmHg or diastolic exceeds 120 mmHg, or if accompanied by chest pain, headache, or visual disturbances.

description: The intake of appropriate nutrients necessary for body maintenance, growth, immunity, and optimal organ function.
prevention: Eat a colorful variety of fruits, whole grains, lean proteins, legumes, and healthy fats. Minimize ultra-processed foods, refined sugar, and trans fats. Drink 2-3 liters of water.
when_to_seek_help: Consult a clinical dietitian if experiencing unintended weight changes, severe nutrient deficiencies, eating disorders, or chronic digestive trouble.

description: The administration of antigenic material to stimulate an individual's immune system to develop adaptive immunity against specific pathogens.
prevention: Follow national immunization schedules for infants, children, and adults. Ensure boosters for tetanus, flu, hepatitis, and travel vaccines as recommended.
when_to_seek_help: Consult a doctor immediately if a vaccine recipient exhibits signs of anaphylaxis, such as swelling of face or throat, hives, or breathing difficulty.

description: Practices and habits that help maintain health and prevent the spread of pathogenic bacteria, viruses, and parasites.
prevention: Wash hands thoroughly with soap for at least 20 seconds. Store food safely, drink filtered or boiled water, and maintain sanitization of frequently touched surfaces.
when_to_seek_help: Consult a doctor if you develop persistent diarrhea, skin abscesses, or signs of systemic infection following contact with contaminated water or soil.

description: A state of psychological and emotional well-being that enables people to cope with stress, realize their abilities, and work productively.
prevention: Practice mindfulness, diaphragmatic breathing, ensure 7-8 hours of restful sleep, engage in physical activities, and cultivate social connections.
when_to_seek_help: Reach out to a mental health professional or counselor if experiencing persistent hopelessness, debilitating panic attacks, or thoughts of self-harm.

description: A chronic respiratory condition causing inflammation and narrowing of the airways, leading to wheezing, chest tightness, and coughing.
prevention: Identify and avoid known triggers (pollen, dust mites, cold dry air, tobacco smoke). Keep prescribed rescue inhalers accessible at all times.
when_to_seek_help: Seek immediate emergency care if blue lips/nails develop, breathing becomes labored, or rescue inhalers provide no relief within minutes.

description: Pain arising from head or upper neck structures. Can range from tension-type headaches to neurological migraines.
prevention: Maintain regular sleep schedules, avoid prolonged screen glare, stay hydrated, reduce caffeine fluctuations, and manage stress.
when_to_seek_help: Seek immediate emergency care if the headache is sudden and explosive ('thunderclap'), or follows head trauma, or is accompanied by confusion or numbness.

description: Cardiovascular health involves the proper functioning of the heart and blood vessels, preventing atherosclerotic coronary disease.
prevention: Engage in cardiovascular exercises (brisk walking, swimming), eat heart-healthy omega-3s and fiber, manage blood pressure and cholesterol, avoid smoking.
when_to_seek_help: Call emergency services (112) immediately for crushing chest pain radiating to left arm or jaw, cold sweats, nausea, or severe lightheadedness.

description: An immune response to foreign substances that are typically harmless, such as pollen, pet dander, insect stings, or specific foods.
prevention: Use hypoallergenic bedding, monitor local pollen counts, carry prescribed antihistamines, and avoid known food allergens.
when_to_seek_help: Call 112 immediately if experiencing anaphylaxis symptoms: lip or tongue swelling, throat tightness, dizziness, or difficulty breathing.

description: The overall wellness of the gastrointestinal tract, addressing acid reflux (GERD), constipation, bloating, and gastritis.
prevention: Eat smaller, frequent meals. Avoid lying down within 2 hours after meals. Increase dietary fiber gradually and reduce greasy or excessively spicy food.
when_to_seek_help: Consult a gastroenterologist if experiencing difficulty swallowing, persistent abdominal pain, vomiting blood, or black tarry stools.

description: Immediate assistance provided to a person suffering a sudden illness or injury, until full medical treatment is available.
prevention: Keep a certified first aid kit at home. For minor burns, cool under clean running water for 10 minutes. For bleeding, apply firm, direct pressure with a clean cloth.
when_to_seek_help: Seek emergency medical care for deep puncture wounds, severe bleeding that doesn't stop after 5 minutes of pressure, or potential fractures.

description: Immediate clinical intervention required for acute life-threatening emergencies. In India, dial 112 for unified emergency services.
prevention: Memorize emergency helpline 112 and local ambulance numbers. Learn bystander CPR and basic Heimlich maneuver for choking victims.
when_to_seek_help: Dial 112 or visit the nearest emergency room immediately for cardiac arrest, severe trauma, stroke signs (FAST), severe burns, or poisoning.
